eligibility_reasoning: Witness entirely in p in (0,1). 2019 survey (jmi-13-58) Conjecture 5.1, by authors including 2 of 3 source authors, restates the live conjecture on (1, infinity) with deliberately adjusted derived clause (p>1 to p>2) and no counterexample. Reviewer numerics (two independent 50-dps methods) show concavity holds at every sampled p>1 at x=1/4096 (D(2)=-1.078e-11; asymptotically provable via strictly convex deficit x^(p+1)/(p(p+1))) and at x=0.9; the surviving (1,inf) conjecture is untouched and open. Established result therefore corrects the source's parameter domain without resolving any surviving open question: a parameter-domain correction under the strict standard, despite the literal (0,inf) quantifier and the genuinely new, non-trivial witness (source's own computer experiments missed it). Karp-Prilepkina 2015/2024 concern forward functions (sinh_p, sinh_{p,q} log-convex; sin_{p,q} concave) and say nothing about arcsinh_p concavity in p; literal directions checked. p->0 flatness alone does not contradict concavity (F->0 compatible with concavity); no existing parameter-limit theorem implies the failure.
